description: Generate and edit HappyHorse videos, then retrieve the same video task through Ace Data Cloud. Independently provided by Ace Data Cloud; not the model vendor's official integration. Connect using the Streamable HTTP URL: https://happyhorse.mcp.acedata.cloud/mcp. Authorize with your MCP client and check your account access and [current pricing](https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/happyhorse?utm_source=opensource&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=evergreen) before generating.
